review: Visible duplicate-heading removal; no change to the documented procedure, translated copy or operational behavior.

files.reason: This is a visible layout correction: the Covers editor removes its redundant inner heading and retains the existing outer heading. It follows the existing Courses empty-title pattern; CSS outside that removed heading is unchanged. The four radio labels, accessible names, selected values, validation, mode/default scoping, staged draft, cancel/discard protection and save payload are unchanged. Existing FR/HE/EN procedures describe choosing and saving cover/seat tracking, not a duplicated title or these pixel offsets. No translated copy, article, guide screenshot, date, public search or support corpus change is required. No pixel-equivalence claim is made without a Square Covers reference.
